o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: A true dark-roast substitute for Monsoon Dark (or an explicit sourcing note), the founder-approval flag on the group-5 discount, and a sharper voice pass so the drafts sound like 'tell us how you brew' rather than template mail.

o2.biggest_strength: Warmest, most on-brand draft copy and the widest range of ideas - equipment-only, cold-brew seasonality, a day-28 'running low' nudge, free-shipping vs discount test, and a clear delivery gate for ex-subscribers.
o2.biggest_mistake: Wrong priority order: it starts with the 91-180 group instead of the 46-90 at-risk customers, and the value model leans on invented multi-order assumptions and ~70% reach that don't match the 62%/40% opt-in data, so the ₹8.5 lakh headline is softer than the 'every rupee checked' claim.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Put the 46-90 day window first, replace the assumption-heavy ₹999/₹2,113-per-buyer model with per-order gross profit like Output 1, tie reach to the actual opt-in rates, and flag any 15% use for founder approval.
